messages:
harper: onboarding snag — followed the quickstart, CLI shows \"first call passed\" but our service account POST to /v1/generate returns 401 then a 302 to billing. workspace created by SSO invite, no billing card. anyone run into mixed auth/billing redirects? :thinking:

drew: can you paste the headers? might be token scope vs user vs service-account logic.

harper: minimal curl (service acct):
```
$ curl -i -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer sa-xxxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":{"code":"unauthenticated","message":"service account requires workspace association"}}
```
then retrying the CLI token path returns 302 when we try the same request with the user token: 302 -> console/billing/checkout

ivy: ah — the gateway had a race: token refresh path sets a transient cookie and UI-layer intercept sees user token without billing and issues HTML redirect. service accounts should get machine-readable errors (403/401 with JSON) and never an HTML redirect.

auth-bot: flagged: AUTH-1984 — gateway content-negotiation and token-type routing.

sdk-team: quick note: our SDK refresh wrapper currently retries auth failures and then retries the original request; if the retry returns a 302 it may follow and produce HTML. We should treat 3xx as terminal for POSTs and ensure SDKs set Accept: application/json by default.

harper: workaround for CI: ensure client sets Accept header and force redirect: 'manual' in fetch or disable auto-follow in HTTP client. For service accounts, make sure the SA is bound to a workspace with billing, or use a user token for initial onboarding flow.

drew: filing INF-7710 to (1) prevent HTML 302 for non-browser token types, (2) update SDKs to default Accept: application/json and make 3xx terminal for non-idempotent methods, (3) add clearer error codes for service-account vs billing problems.

auth-bot: INF-7710 created and canary scheduled.

harper: confirmed workaround works; adding Accept + manual redirect to our CI stopped HTML snapshots. will watch INF-7710. thanks all :thumbsup:
